statement: For every arr satisfying the preconditions, whenever maximum_sum(arr) returns a result r, r equals the maximum value among all valid choices, where a valid choice is either (a) a non-empty contiguous subarray arr[l..u] with 0 <= l <= u < len(arr), whose value is sum_{i=l}^{u} arr[i], or (b) a contiguous subarray arr[l..u] with 0 <= l <= u < len(arr) and u - l + 1 >= 2, together with a deleted index d with l <= d <= u, whose value is sum_{i=l}^{u} arr[i] - arr[d].
preconditions: len(arr) >= 1, len(arr) <= 100000, and -10000 <= arr[i] <= 10000 for every i with 0 <= i < len(arr).

statement: For every arr satisfying the preconditions, maximum_sum(arr) returns a result (it does not fail, panic, or overflow).
preconditions: len(arr) >= 1, len(arr) <= 100000, and -10000 <= arr[i] <= 10000 for every i with 0 <= i < len(arr).

statement: For every arr satisfying the preconditions, whenever maximum_sum(arr) returns a result r, there exist l and u with 0 <= l <= u < len(arr) and either no deleted index or a deleted index d with l <= d <= u and u - l + 1 >= 2 such that r equals sum_{i=l}^{u} arr[i] when no index is deleted, and r equals sum_{i=l}^{u} arr[i] - arr[d] when d is deleted.
preconditions: len(arr) >= 1, len(arr) <= 100000, and -10000 <= arr[i] <= 10000 for every i with 0 <= i < len(arr).

statement: For every arr satisfying the preconditions, whenever maximum_sum(arr) returns a result r, for every l and u with 0 <= l <= u < len(arr), and for every choice of either no deletion or a deleted index d with l <= d <= u and u - l + 1 >= 2, the value sum_{i=l}^{u} arr[i] (if no deletion) or sum_{i=l}^{u} arr[i] - arr[d] (if d is deleted) is at most r.
preconditions: len(arr) >= 1, len(arr) <= 100000, and -10000 <= arr[i] <= 10000 for every i with 0 <= i < len(arr).

statement: For every arr satisfying the preconditions, whenever maximum_sum(arr) returns a result r, -10000 <= r <= 1000000000.
preconditions: len(arr) >= 1, len(arr) <= 100000, and -10000 <= arr[i] <= 10000 for every i with 0 <= i < len(arr).

statement: For every arr satisfying the preconditions, whenever maximum_sum(arr) returns a result r, for every index i with 0 <= i < len(arr), arr[i] <= r.
preconditions: len(arr) >= 1, len(arr) <= 100000, and -10000 <= arr[i] <= 10000 for every i with 0 <= i < len(arr).

statement: For every arr satisfying the preconditions, whenever maximum_sum(arr) returns a result r, r <= sum_{0 <= i < len(arr), arr[i] > 0} arr[i].
preconditions: len(arr) >= 1, len(arr) <= 100000, and -10000 <= arr[i] <= 10000 for every i with 0 <= i < len(arr).

statement: For every arr satisfying the preconditions and len(arr) = 1, whenever maximum_sum(arr) returns a result r, r = arr[0].
preconditions: len(arr) >= 1, len(arr) <= 100000, -10000 <= arr[i] <= 10000 for every i with 0 <= i < len(arr), and len(arr) = 1.

statement: For every arr satisfying the preconditions and len(arr) = 2, whenever maximum_sum(arr) returns a result r, r = max(arr[0], arr[1], arr[0] + arr[1]).
preconditions: len(arr) >= 1, len(arr) <= 100000, -10000 <= arr[i] <= 10000 for every i with 0 <= i < len(arr), and len(arr) = 2.

statement: For every arr satisfying the preconditions and with arr[i] <= 0 for every 0 <= i < len(arr), whenever maximum_sum(arr) returns a result r, r = max_{0 <= i < len(arr)} arr[i].
preconditions: len(arr) >= 1, len(arr) <= 100000, -10000 <= arr[i] <= 10000 for every i with 0 <= i < len(arr), and arr[i] <= 0 for every 0 <= i < len(arr).

statement: For every arr satisfying the preconditions and with arr[i] >= 0 for every 0 <= i < len(arr), whenever maximum_sum(arr) returns a result r, r = sum_{i=0}^{len(arr)-1} arr[i].
preconditions: len(arr) >= 1, len(arr) <= 100000, -10000 <= arr[i] <= 10000 for every i with 0 <= i < len(arr), and arr[i] >= 0 for every 0 <= i < len(arr).

statement: For every arr satisfying the preconditions and having exactly one negative entry at index k, whenever maximum_sum(arr) returns a result r, r = sum_{0 <= i < len(arr), i != k} arr[i].
preconditions: len(arr) >= 2, len(arr) <= 100000, -10000 <= arr[i] <= 10000 for every i with 0 <= i < len(arr), and there is exactly one index k with 0 <= k < len(arr) and arr[k] < 0.

statement: For every arr satisfying the preconditions and having exactly one positive entry at index k, whenever maximum_sum(arr) returns a result r, r = arr[k].
preconditions: len(arr) >= 1, len(arr) <= 100000, -10000 <= arr[i] <= 10000 for every i with 0 <= i < len(arr), and there is exactly one index k with 0 <= k < len(arr) and arr[k] > 0.

statement: For every arr satisfying the preconditions, whenever maximum_sum(arr) returns a result r, there exist l and u with 0 <= l <= u < len(arr) and either no deleted index or a deleted index d with l <= d <= u and u - l + 1 >= 2 such that the corresponding value equals r, and either no deletion is used or arr[d] < 0.
preconditions: len(arr) >= 1, len(arr) <= 100000, and -10000 <= arr[i] <= 10000 for every i with 0 <= i < len(arr).
